From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme procurement - post-call recap & next steps

Hi Jordan - great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery + next steps so procurement has context: 

Call highlights:
- Use case: Acme wants to add a LLM-based search assistant to the internal knowledge base (pilot 3 months, ~5k queries/day).
- Data & security: pilot will only use non-sensitive public KB; enterprise deployment later may use VPC/private.
- Objectives: validate latency and cost, then move to a 12-18 month committed Dedicated contract if pilot successful.

Commercial path options we discussed:
1) Card for pilot (fastest) - immediate onboarding, monthly billing.
2) PO/contract for pilot or enterprise (preferred by procurement) - standard Net30, Redwood Master Services Agreement + SOW, procurement sign-off required.
3) Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) - useful for SaaS procurement flows; billing via AWS but adds onboarding time for listing/contract mapping.

Ask / next steps:
- Jordan: confirm which commercial path procurement prefers (card vs PO vs marketplace) and expected procurement lead time.
- I will send a one-page quote and the SOC2 summary + DOC link.
- If PO, please share any standard PO language or PO contact for legal.

Attaching: one-page quote for pilot (Redwood-Quote-Acme-20260901.pdf).

Thanks - I'll follow up next week if I don't hear back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0182

From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement - post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa - helpful recap. A few notes from procurement: 

- Likely path: procurement wants a PO for any vendor work tied to a project budget. Card is acceptable for very small pilot spend but will need leadership approval.
- Marketplace: procurement prefers AWS Marketplace for anything that simplifies vendor management, but they need confirmation that usage will show up in the AWS bill and that we get equivalent support terms.
- Timeline: procurement cycle is ~2-3 weeks for small pilots once they have the quote + SOW; for enterprise contracts it can stretch to 6-8 weeks.

Questions for you:
1) Can you provide a short SOW (1 page) we can attach to the PO?
2) Is Redwood already onboarded to AWS Marketplace or would that be a parallel track?
3) Any flex on trial pricing for a 3-month pilot?

Jordan Hale
Senior Program Manager, Acme Corporation
j.hale@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement - post-call recap & next steps

Jordan - appreciate the quick note. Answers below and attaching the 1-page SOW as requested.

1) SOW: attached a concise SOW covering scope (pilot objectives, success metrics), timeline (90 days), and trial quotas. File: Redwood-SOW-Acme-20260908.pdf (attached).
2) AWS Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace but mapping billing to your AWS account requires AWS onboarding steps; this usually adds 1-2 additional weeks. If you want to prioritize speed, card or direct PO are faster.
3) Trial pricing: we can offer a pilot credit of $10k applied to the first month for qualifying pilots; otherwise standard pilot pricing (see attached one-pager).

Commercial recommendation based on similar customers: start pilot on a PO (Net30) so procurement has visibility and finance can track, but enable immediate access via a temporary card or invoice to avoid delays. We can convert to marketplace later for enterprise rollouts.

Next steps:
- Jordan: confirm PO contact + any required PO language (billing address, remit-to).
- Procurement: review attached SOW and quote; tentative start: 2026-09-20 if PO clears.

Attachments:
- Redwood-Quote-Acme-20260901.pdf
- Redwood-SOW-Acme-20260908.pdf
- SOC2-Summary-Redwood-2025.pdf (link to shared drive included)

Thanks - looping in Olga (security/compliance) for SOC2 & evidence if you need deeper artifacts.

Best,
Marissa
